sections.head: Turn the plan into automated tests

items.q: What is a test planning tool?
items.a: A test planning tool helps a team decide what to test in a release, how much coverage each requirement needs and in what order to run tests.

items.q: How does an AI test planner work?
items.a: You describe the release or pick Jira epics. The AI proposes scope, maps each requirement to scenarios, ranks them by risk and generates tests.

items.q: Can the plan become automated tests?
items.a: Yes. Approved scenarios can be run manually or turned into automated tests with KaneAI.

items.q: Is the test planner a separate product?
items.a: No. The AI test planner is part of TestMu AI Test Manager.
Test Planner is part of Test Manager. The Free Forever plan covers unlimited projects and test cases; Premium starts at $49 per user per month, billed annually.
